name: MRI Registration QC (T1w)
summary: Checks the quality of a T1-weighted image registration by computing similarity metrics (NMI, NCC, MSE, SSIM) between a fixed and a registered moving image and producing checkerboard, edge-overlay and difference QC figures.
description: Reorients both images to RAS+, averages 4-D images over time, resamples the moving image into the fixed grid if needed, then computes normalised mutual information, normalised cross-correlation, mean squared error and SSIM with a qualitative label (excellent/good/fair/poor). It writes metrics.json and per-view PNG figures (fixed, moving, checkerboard with edge overlay, absolute difference), plus AFNI edge-alignment montages when AFNI is available. Use it after a registration App to check alignment; it does not change the images.

inputs.description: Registered (moving) T1-weighted image to compare with the fixed image.
inputs.requirements: Should already be registered to the fixed image; a different voxel grid is resampled with the affine.

outputs.description: QC figures (PNG) for axial, coronal and sagittal views and the similarity metrics.

parameters.description: A visualization that alternates patches of two images in a checkerboard pattern to highlight local alignment differences.

failure_modes.message: Error: 'fixed' image path is missing from config.json
Error: 'moving' image path is missing from config.json
